claims.text: Introducing a nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation into the CoCrFeNi matrix will maintain low coefficient of friction from room temperature to 800 °C.
Introducing a nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation into the CoCrFeNi matrix will maintain a low wear rate from room temperature to 800 °C.
The nanohierarchical architecture with composition undulation promotes formation of a stable tribofilm.
The stable tribofilm reduces the coefficient of friction across the test regime.
The stable tribofilm reduces the wear rate across the test regime.
The intervention will reduce coefficient of friction by 30% relative to the starting CoCrFeNi material.
The intervention will reduce wear rate by 25% relative to the starting CoCrFeNi material.
The proposed performance range is room temperature to 800 °C under a 10 N load in a dry environment.
